modelDescription: The Steiner M830rc X LRF 1535 is the with an integrated rangefinder that measures up to 10,000 meters, integrated compass and inclinometer, the M830rc X provides the precise location of the chosen object. With connectivity to external devices, the LRF can be enhanced with additional information depending on the application, making it a high performance binocular perfect for any application. Connectivity to different external devices via Bluetooth and/or cable connection. Relevant devices: STEINER M7Xi IFS, tablet via Steiner App, smartphone via Steiner App for remote operation, Kestrel, Garmin watch, and others. Includes neck strap, lens covers, rain protection cover and tripod mount.
